## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` needs fixing before merge. When `require_shall=True` is set, users who follow the hint get every criterion rejected, and that option is one the pull request says it keeps.

## Changes
The pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` to ask for direct action bullets without the word "shall", and rewords `BULLET_HINT` to show the exact `- ` prefix. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make CRITERION_HINT match the require_shall mode — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion written the way the new hint says, such as `"- Save the result"`, is rejected because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` (app/criteria.py:8). `tests/test_criteria.py:21` asserts that rejection. — Deployments that enable `require_shall` tell users to write criteria that the validator then rejects, so users cannot get a criterion accepted by following the hint. — Fix: Choose the hint based on `require_shall`, or reword it so it does not forbid "shall".
